title: Nobunaga no Yabou Tenshouki
overview: Nobunaga no Yabou: Tenshouki is a tactical strategy game set in 16th century feudal Japan. It is the sixth game in the Nobunaga's Ambition war simulation series. The player can educate warlords and increase their fighting power. He/she can let them go into battle and check their statuses in the meantime. It is possible to have dozens of opponents fighting alone in a given scenario.
